annotations.title: Bring in a 3D model from a link

description: Download an STL or 3MF model from a public https link (a direct download, not a web page) and stage it on Printlooper, where its geometry is checked. Works signed in (to list it) or not (to order a print). Files up to 50 MB. Then call get_staged_file until status is ready.

model_file.description: A file the user attached, as the file object an app passes to tools. Leave out when you have no download_url for it

url.description: A public https link that downloads the .stl or .3mf file

name: stage_model_from_url
title: Bring in a 3D model from a link
